description.value: World Wrap Place is a family-run Middle Eastern fast food counter in Vancouver's historic Gastown neighbourhood, founded in 2005 by Chef Majid Shekarchi. The menu revolves around donairs, wraps, and platters built from local farm-fresh ingredients, with full halal certification. It is a compact, takeout-friendly stop offering both meat and vegetarian or vegan options a short ride from the central waterfront cycling routes.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 81m; stands at 97m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at worldwrapplace.ca is live and corroborates the OSM record: phone 604-862-4983 appears on both the About Us and Contact pages, and the address is confirmed as 101-68 Water Street, Vancouver. Takeout is explicitly promoted via a prominent homepage link and the contact page; the website product collections include a dedicated 'Vegetarian / Vegan 5 products' category and a Vegetarian Falafel Wrap, confirming those dietary options. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: Website contains conflicting information between the Contact page (which states the business is closed on weekends) and the footer on all other pages (which lists Saturday hours), suggesting the Contact page content may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible fast food restaurant in Gastown with a fully confirmed website, matching phone and address, and active online menu. A practical food stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website product collections include a labelled 'Vegetarian / Vegan 5 products' section; individual items include the Vegetarian Falafel Wrap and a Falafel Platter

wow_evidence: family-run Middle Eastern fast food counter in Vancouver's historic Gastown neighbourhood, founded in 2005
